description:
Get a specific task by ID from Holded Projects.

Args:
  - task_id (string): The task ID to retrieve (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Task details including name, status, priority, due date, and assignee.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_projects_get_task
title: Get Holded Task
